name: Deskus – Russian Help Desk
author: deskus

sections.description:
Deskus™ (Дескус) is a help desk for businesses: tickets, chats, messengers, calls and a knowledge base in one place. This plugin connects a WordPress site to your Deskus account in a few minutes, without editing theme files.

Support widget

  • Paste the widget code from Deskus — the chat button appears on the site.
  • Choose where it shows: on all pages, only on selected pages, or everywhere except selected ones. The front page, blog posts and archives can be chosen too.
  • Widget look, working hours and greetings are set in Deskus and change without touching the site.

Forms become tickets

  • Submissions from Contact Form 7, WPForms (Lite and Pro), Elementor Forms (Elementor Pro), Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Forminator and Formidable Forms arrive in Deskus as tickets.
  • Name, email and phone go into the client card, so repeat requests from one person land in one conversation. The other fields go into the ticket text, together with the form title and the page it was sent from.
  • Choose which forms to pass: every form has its own checkbox. Elementor forms are found on the site pages.
  • If Deskus is briefly unreachable, the submission is queued and sent again later — nothing is lost.
  • The delivery log on the settings page shows the last 20 submissions and why one failed. Only the result is logged, not the submitted data.

Your own forms

  • A form made by the theme or a page builder: add the class deskus-send to the form tag, or list its CSS selector in the settings. The form keeps working as before, and a copy of what was filled in goes to Deskus. Passwords and hidden fields are not sent.
  • From your own PHP code: do_action( 'deskus_submit', array( 'form' => 'Order', 'fields' => array( 'name' => $name, 'email' => $email ) ) ); — with the same retry queue and delivery log.

Contact form shortcode

No form plugin? Add [deskus_form] to any page. Fields, required fields, button text and title are set in the shortcode:

[deskus_form title="Write to us" fields="name,email,phone,message" required="email,message"]

The form has a consent checkbox with a link to your privacy policy page, spam protection without captcha and works with or without JavaScript.

What you need

A Deskus account. Sign up at deskus.ru.

External services

This plugin connects the site to Deskus, a help desk service run by the Deskus team (deskus.ru). It is needed for the plugin to work.

  • Support widget. When a widget code is set, every page where the widget is shown loads a script from the Deskus address (by default https://app.deskus.ru/widget/embed). The visitor’s browser sends the usual request data: IP address, browser, page address. What a visitor writes in the chat is sent to Deskus.
  • Forms. When an inbound address is set, every submission of a form passed to Deskus (form plugins, [deskus_form], the deskus_submit action) is sent from your server to that address: the form title, field values, page address and the secret key, if set. The “Check the address” button sends a request without data.
  • Other forms on the site. When this option is on, a marked form also sends a copy of the filled-in fields from the visitor’s browser to your own site (admin-post.php), and your server passes it to Deskus as above. Passwords and hidden fields are not sent.

Deskus terms of use and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the deskus folder to /wp-content/plugins/, and activate it.
  2. Open Settings → Deskus.
  3. Widget: in Deskus, open Settings → Channels → Website widgets → your widget → Installation, copy the code and paste it into “Widget code”.
  4. Forms: in Deskus, open Settings → Channels → Forms and API → WordPress → Connect, copy the address and paste it into “Inbound address”. If you set a secret key in the channel, enter it too.
  5. Save, then press “Send a test request” — a test ticket appears in Deskus.
sections.faq:
Can I reply to a client through the form?

No, a form only sends. Reply from the ticket by email or phone: Deskus takes them from the form.

Are files from forms passed to Deskus?

No. The ticket says that a file was attached and what it was called.

My form plugin is not in the list

Mark the form with the class deskus-send or its CSS selector in “Other forms on the site”, or send it from PHP with the deskus_submit action. Form plugins with a webhook option can also send to the same inbound address directly. The deskus_submission_payload filter lets you change what is sent.

Is a form sent twice if it is both in a form plugin and marked with deskus-send?

Yes, so mark only forms that no supported plugin handles. Deskus recognizes an exact repeat and does not create a second ticket.

Does the widget slow the site down?

The widget loader is a small script loaded asynchronously in the footer; the chat itself opens in a frame only when a visitor uses it.

What happens to the data if I delete the plugin?

Settings, the retry queue and the delivery log are removed. Tickets already created stay in Deskus.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Forminator and Formidable Forms submissions as tickets, with a checkbox for every form.
  • Elementor forms are found on the site pages and listed with checkboxes.
  • Other forms on the site: mark a theme or page builder form with the class deskus-send or a CSS selector, and a copy of every submission goes to Deskus.
  • For developers: the deskus_submit action and the deskus_submit() function.

1.0.1

  • Contact form shortcode: nonce check for every submission, a fresh nonce is fetched before sending so cached pages keep working.
  • Contact form shortcode: fixed background sending when JavaScript is enabled.
  • Translations are now delivered by translate.wordpress.org.

1.0.0

  • First release: support widget with page selection, Contact Form 7, WPForms and Elementor Forms submissions as tickets, retry queue and delivery log, [deskus_form] shortcode.
